opinions: ECONOMIC GLOBALIZATION SHOULD BE STEERED TO BENEFIT HUMANITY AND REDUCE POVERTY, NOT MERELY MAXIMIZE CORPORATE PROFITS.
I CANNOT SUPPORT MY COUNTRY WHEN IT IS WRONG; BLIND NATIONALISM CONTRADICTS ETHICAL PRINCIPLES AND MY TRAINING TO VALUE TRUTH AND HUMAN RIGHTS.
IT IS INDEED FOOLISH TO FEEL PRIDE IN ONE'S COUNTRY OF BIRTH SINCE NO ONE CHOOSES IT, THOUGH ONE CAN STILL VALUE AND CONTRIBUTE TO ITS POSITIVE TRADITIONS.
NO RACE HAS SUPERIOR QUALITIES OVER OTHERS; ALL HUMANS SHARE EQUAL INHERENT WORTH REGARDLESS OF RACIAL BACKGROUND.
THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY MY FRIEND; ALLIANCES SHOULD BE BASED ON SHARED VALUES AND ETHICS RATHER THAN PURE OPPORTUNISM.
MILITARY ACTION THAT DEFIES INTERNATIONAL LAW IS RARELY JUSTIFIED AND SETS DANGEROUS PRECEDENTS THAT UNDERMINE GLOBAL STABILITY.
THE FUSION OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT HAS INDEED BECOME WORRYING, AS IT DEGRADES PUBLIC DISCOURSE AND MAKES CITIZENS EASIER TO MANIPULATE.
CLASS DIVISIONS REMAIN AMONG THE MOST POWERFUL FORCES SHAPING PEOPLE'S OPPORTUNITIES AND PERSPECTIVES, OFTEN CUTTING ACROSS NATIONALITY.
CONTROLLING UNEMPLOYMENT IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN CONTROLLING INFLATION BECAUSE HUMAN WELFARE AND DIGNITY SHOULD TAKE PRECEDENCE OVER MONETARY STABILITY.
CORPORATIONS REQUIRE STRONG REGULATION TO PROTECT THE ENVIRONMENT, AS VOLUNTARY MEASURES HAVE CONSISTENTLY PROVEN INADEQUATE.
“FROM EACH ACCORDING TO HIS ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO HIS NEED” CAPTURES AN IMPORTANT MORAL IDEAL, EVEN IF ITS IMPLEMENTATION HAS OFTEN FAILED.
THE FREER THE MARKET IS NOT ALWAYS THE FREER THE PEOPLE; UNREGULATED MARKETS CAN CREATE COERCIVE POWER IMBALANCES.
IT IS INDEED A SAD REFLECTION ON SOCIETY THAT DRINKING WATER HAS BECOME A BRANDED COMMODITY RATHER THAN A UNIVERSALLY ACCESSIBLE PUBLIC GOOD.
LAND SHOULD NOT BE TREATED PURELY AS A COMMODITY; IT IS A FINITE RESOURCE THAT CARRIES COMMUNAL AND ECOLOGICAL RESPONSIBILITIES.
IT IS REGRETTABLE THAT MANY PERSONAL FORTUNES ARE ACCUMULATED THROUGH FINANCIAL MANIPULATION WITHOUT CREATING GENUINE SOCIETAL VALUE.
PROTECTIONISM IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY TO PROTECT STRATEGIC INDUSTRIES, WORKERS, AND FOOD SECURITY FROM DESTRUCTIVE TRADE PRACTICES.
THE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY OF A COMPANY EXTENDS BEYOND DELIVERING PROFITS TO SHAREHOLDERS; IT INCLUDES ETHICAL TREATMENT OF WORKERS, COMMUNITIES, AND THE ENVIRONMENT.
THE RICH ARE NOT TOO HIGHLY TAXED IN MOST DEVELOPED COUNTRIES; MANY WEALTHY INDIVIDUALS AND CORPORATIONS PAY DISPROPORTIONATELY LOW EFFECTIVE TAX RATES.
THOSE WHO CAN PAY SHOULD NOT HAVE ACCESS TO FUNDAMENTALLY HIGHER STANDARDS OF MEDICAL CARE; HEALTHCARE IS A HUMAN RIGHT THAT SHOULD NOT BE STRATIFIED BY WEALTH.
GOVERNMENTS SHOULD PENALIZE BUSINESSES THAT MISLEAD THE PUBLIC, AS DECEPTION UNDERMINES INFORMED CONSENT AND FAIR MARKETS.
A GENUINE FREE MARKET DOES REQUIRE RESTRICTIONS ON PREDATOR MULTINATIONALS CREATING MONOPOLIES, AS MONOPOLIES DESTROY COMPETITION AND FREEDOM.
ABORTION SHOULD BE LEGAL AND ACCESSIBLE, ESPECIALLY IN EARLY STAGES; FORCING WOMEN TO CARRY PREGNANCIES AGAINST THEIR WILL VIOLATES BODILY AUTONOMY.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD INDEED BE QUESTIONED; SKEPTICISM TOWARD POWER IS ESSENTIAL FOR A HEALTHY SOCIETY.
AN EYE FOR AN EYE IS A PRIMITIVE AND COUNTERPRODUCTIVE PRINCIPLE OF JUSTICE THAT PERPETUATES CYCLES OF VIOLENCE.
TAXPAYERS SHOULD SUPPORT THEATRES AND MUSEUMS THAT CANNOT SURVIVE COMMERCIALLY BECAUSE CULTURE ENRICHES SOCIETY BEYOND MARKET LOGIC.
SCHOOLS SHOULD MAKE CLASSROOM ATTENDANCE COMPULSORY BECAUSE EDUCATION IS A FUNDAMENTAL PUBLIC GOOD THAT REQUIRES STRUCTURE FOR ALL CHILDREN.
IT IS NOT BETTER FOR DIFFERENT SORTS OF PEOPLE TO KEEP TO THEIR OWN KIND; DIVERSITY AND INTEGRATION STRENGTHEN SOCIETIES WHEN PAIRED WITH SHARED VALUES.
GOOD PARENTS DO NOT NEED TO SPANK THEIR CHILDREN; THERE ARE MORE EFFECTIVE, NON-VIOLENT METHODS OF DISCIPLINE THAT RESPECT THE CHILD'S DIGNITY.
IT IS NATURAL AND HEALTHY FOR CHILDREN TO KEEP SOME SECRETS FROM THEIR PARENTS AS THEY DEVELOP AUTONOMY AND PERSONAL BOUNDARIES.
POSSESSING MARIJUANA FOR PERSONAL USE SHOULD NOT BE A CRIMINAL OFFENCE; IT IS AN INEFFICIENT AND UNJUST USE OF STATE POWER.
THE PRIME FUNCTION OF SCHOOLING SHOULD BE TO CREATE THOUGHTFUL, INFORMED, AND ETHICAL CITIZENS, NOT MERELY TO PREPARE PEOPLE FOR JOBS.
NO ONE SHOULD BE PROHIBITED FROM REPRODUCING BASED ON INHERITABLE DISABILITIES; EUGENICS IS MORALLY ABHORRENT.
THE MOST IMPORTANT THING FOR CHILDREN TO LEARN IS CRITICAL THINKING, EMPATHY, AND PERSONAL RESPONSIBILITY RATHER THAN MERE OBEDIENCE TO DISCIPLINE.
THERE ARE NO INHERENTLY SAVAGE OR CIVILIZED PEOPLES; THERE ARE ONLY DIFFERENT CULTURES WITH VARYING STRENGTHS, FLAWS, AND MORAL PROGRESS.
THOSE WHO ARE ABLE TO WORK AND REFUSE REASONABLE OPPORTUNITIES SHOULD NOT EXPECT INDEFINITE SOCIETAL SUPPORT WITHOUT CONTRIBUTION.
WHEN TROUBLED, IT IS GENERALLY BETTER TO PROCESS AND UNDERSTAND ONE'S FEELINGS RATHER THAN SIMPLY DISTRACT ONESELF WITH CHEERIER THINGS.
FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN BECOME FULLY INTEGRATED WITHIN THEIR NEW COUNTRY; INTEGRATION IS A REALISTIC AND DESIRABLE OUTCOME.
WHAT IS GOOD FOR THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS OFTEN NOT GOOD FOR ORDINARY PEOPLE OR THE ENVIRONMENT.
INDEPENDENT PUBLIC BROADCASTING INSTITUTIONS LIKE THE BBC DESERVE PUBLIC FUNDING TO PROVIDE INFORMATION FREE FROM COMMERCIAL OR POLITICAL CAPTURE.
CIVIL LIBERTIES HAVE BEEN EXCESSIVELY CURBED IN THE NAME OF COUNTER-TERRORISM, OFTEN CREATING UNNECESSARY SURVEILLANCE STATES.
THERE IS NO SIGNIFICANT ADVANTAGE TO A ONE-PARTY STATE; AVOIDING ARGUMENTS DOES NOT PRODUCE BETTER GOVERNANCE, ONLY AUTHORITARIANISM.
EVEN IF YOU HAVE DONE NOTHING WRONG, OFFICIAL SURVEILLANCE IN THE ELECTRONIC AGE SHOULD WORRY EVERYONE WHO VALUES PRIVACY AND FREEDOM.
THE DEATH PENALTY SHOULD NOT BE AN OPTION; IT IS IRREVERSIBLE, DISPROPORTIONATELY APPLIED, AND DOES NOT DETER CRIME EFFECTIVELY.
A CIVILIZED SOCIETY DOES NOT REQUIRE PERMANENT HIERARCHIES OF PEOPLE ABOVE TO BE OBEYED AND BELOW TO BE COMMANDED; MUTUAL RESPECT IS PREFERABLE.
ABSTRACT ART THAT DOESN’T REPRESENT ANYTHING CAN STILL BE LEGITIMATE ART IF IT EVOKES EMOTION, CONCEPT, OR AESTHETIC RESPONSE.
IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE, REHABILITATION SHOULD GENERALLY BE MORE IMPORTANT THAN PUNISHMENT WHEN IT IS FEASIBLE.
IT IS NOT A WASTE OF TIME TO TRY TO REHABILITATE CRIMINALS; SOCIETY BENEFITS WHEN PEOPLE CAN BE SUCCESSFULLY REINTEGRATED.
WRITERS, ARTISTS, AND CREATORS ARE AT LEAST AS IMPORTANT AS BUSINESSPEOPLE AND MANUFACTURERS BECAUSE THEY SHAPE CULTURE, VALUES, AND MEANING.
MOTHERS MAY HAVE CAREERS, AND THEIR FIRST DUTY IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY TO BE HOMEMAKERS; PARTNERSHIP AND PERSONAL CHOICE SHOULD DETERMINE FAMILY ROLES.
WE SHOULD HEED CLIMATE SCIENCE WARNINGS THAT INFINITE ECONOMIC GROWTH ON A FINITE PLANET IS UNSUSTAINABLE AND DANGEROUS.
MAKING PEACE WITH THE ESTABLISHMENT IS NOT NECESSARILY A MARK OF MATURITY; PRINCIPLED OPPOSITION TO UNJUST SYSTEMS CAN BE MORE MATURE.
ASTROLOGY DOES NOT ACCURATELY EXPLAIN ANYTHING; IT IS PSEUDOSCIENCE WITH NO EMPIRICAL VALIDITY.
YOU CAN BE MORAL WITHOUT BEING RELIGIOUS; ETHICS ARISE FROM REASON, EMPATHY, AND HUMAN WELFARE.
SOCIAL SECURITY IS GENERALLY BETTER THAN PRIVATE CHARITY BECAUSE IT PROVIDES RELIABLE, DIGNIFIED, AND NON-STIGMATIZING SUPPORT AS A RIGHT.
THERE IS NO SUCH THING AS BEING 'NATURALLY UNLUCKY'; OUTCOMES RESULT FROM A COMBINATION OF FACTORS INCLUDING CHANCE, SYSTEMS, AND CHOICES.
IT IS NOT IMPORTANT THAT MY CHILD’S SCHOOL INSTILLS RELIGIOUS VALUES; SCHOOLS SHOULD FOCUS ON EDUCATION, CRITICAL THINKING, AND RESPECT FOR DIVERSITY.
SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS NOT USUALLY IMMORAL WHEN IT INVOLVES CONSENT, RESPONSIBILITY, AND RESPECT BETWEEN ADULTS.
A SAME-SEX COUPLE IN A STABLE, LOVING RELATIONSHIP SHOULD ABSOLUTELY BE ALLOWED TO ADOPT CHILDREN.
PORNOGRAPHY DEPICTING CONSENTING ADULTS SHOULD BE LEGAL FOR ADULTS, THOUGH REGULATION AGAINST EXPLOITATION REMAINS NECESSARY.
WHAT GOES ON IN A PRIVATE BEDROOM BETWEEN CONSENTING ADULTS IS NO BUSINESS OF THE STATE.
PEOPLE CAN AND DO FEEL NATURALLY HOMOSEXUAL; SEXUAL ORIENTATION HAS STRONG BIOLOGICAL COMPONENTS AND IS NOT A CHOICE.
OPENNESS ABOUT SEX HAS NOT GONE TOO FAR; HONEST, CONSENSUAL, AND RESPONSIBLE ATTITUDES TOWARD SEXUALITY REPRESENT SOCIAL PROGRESS.
